sourceRefs.locator: Introduction and Sobre este lugar: foundation in 578 in honour of the king’s son, the commercial street rising to the palace and church, and the site near Zorita de los Canes.
ER 363, About the source: Homoian and Nicene Christians, Reccared’s conversion in 587, the 589 council and manuscript recensions.
Documents 35–36, pp. 278–279: opening and subscriptions to the 589 profession of faith, including Reccared, Queen Baddo and the confirming edict. The editor identifies the later copy.

summary.de: Sohn Leovigilds. Sein Glaubenswechsel 587 ging dem Konzil von Toledo 589 voraus.
summary.en: Son of Liuvigild. His change of religious allegiance in 587 preceded the Council of Toledo in 589.
